requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
requirement.note: Ban on sale/licensing (§98.1103(a)) and tenant remedies (§98.1104) with $1,000 per violation and attorney's fees also stated. Card's 'set or recommend' is a slight paraphrase of the definition (advise/recommend).

key_value.evidence: For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
key_value.note: The $1,000 per violation figure is in §98.1104(a): "civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation of this Division".

status.evidence: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
status.note: Document shows a proposed draft with blank final passage date and unsigned certification, so not yet adopted in the document. 'Pending' is consistent, but the document gives no information on whether it was adopted by 2026-10-01.

citation.evidence: §98.1103  Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
citation.note: Section numbers 98.1101-98.1104 and ordinance number O-2025-107 appear in the document, and the ordinance is marked proposed/draft.
